=Create a sales meeting brief for {{$json.company}}. Meeting: {{$json.meeting_title}}. Date: {{$json.meeting_date}}. Time: {{$json.meeting_time}}. Location: {{$json.meeting_location}}. Context: {{$json.meeting_description}}. Return exactly one valid JSON object. Do not return Markdown, code fences, explanations, or text before or after the JSON. Do not return HTML except inside the brief_html string. Every key below is mandatory. Use concise, commercially useful AI-generated content whenever specific research is unavailable; never use the literal phrase Not Available. { "brief_html": "

Executive Meeting Brief

...

", "meeting_priority": "High", "meeting_readiness_score": "85%", "opportunity_score": "75%", "risk_level": "Medium", "meeting_objective": "...", "executive_summary": "...", "industry": "...", "headquarters": "...", "employees": "...", "revenue": "...", "website": "...", "key_products": ["..."], "latest_news": [{"headline": "...", "summary": "...", "source": "AI market analysis", "impact": "..."}], "competitors": [{"competitor": "...", "strength": "...", "weakness": "...", "recommended_strategy": "..."}], "customer_pain_points": ["..."], "discovery_questions": ["..."], "talking_points": ["..."], "recommended_pitch": "...", "objection_handling": "...", "cross_sell_opportunities": ["..."], "meeting_preparation": ["..."], "documents": ["..."], "follow_up": ["..."], "next_steps": ["..."] } All arrays must be arrays, all other values must be strings, and brief_html must be a non-empty HTML string for the existing UI.

options.systemMessage: You are Saarthi AI, an enterprise sales intelligence assistant. Produce factual, concise, meeting-ready intelligence. Your response is consumed by a strict JSON parser. Return only the required JSON object, with every required key and no Markdown.
